title: Bundle Lock Manifest (v1)
description: Schema for bundles/<bundle_id>/<revision>/manifest.lock.json. Bundle revisions are generated, immutable, hash-locked directory materializations (e.g. a frontend-ready artwork/profile bundle) — never a source of truth. Every file materialized into the revision is listed with its exact-byte SHA-256 so drift from this lock is detectable and treated as failure.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision number for this bundle_id. Must equal the enclosing directory segment.

source_profile_ref.description: The canonical profile (and its content digest at generation time) this revision was materialized from, so it is always traceable back to source.

inputs.description: Asset content addresses consumed to materialize this revision.

immutable.description: Always true. Once written, a revision's files are never edited in place; changes always produce a new revision.

files.description: Every materialized file in this revision, path-relative to the revision root, with its exact-byte hash for lock verification.
